Job Description: 


## Job Description

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Generative AI Engineer to build, optimize, and productionise cutting-edge AI systems. You will focus heavily on backend AI orchestration, framework integration, and model performance. In this role, you will take advanced RAG workflows and multi-agent concepts and turn them into scalable, production-grade enterprise software.

Location- Bangalore, Pune, Chennai

Experience-4 to 7yrs

**Key Responsibilities**

* **AI Orchestration**: Build, test, and optimize bespoke Agentic AI solutions and multi-agent workflows.
* **Core Product Integration**: Co-develop integration pipelines to embed core AI models into client environments.
* **Technical Delivery**: Own the technical lifecycle of AI applications from rapid prototype to stable production release.
* **Optimization & Debugging**: Perform technical debugging, root-cause analysis, and latency/prompt optimizations.
* **Best Practices**: Implement engineering best practices for LLM evaluation, guardrails, and version control.
* **Risk Management**: Identify and flag model drift, data leakage, and system risks early.

**Technical Requirements**

* **GenAI Ecosystem**: 2+ years of hands-on experience building production RAG pipelines and multi-agent systems using LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex.
* **Protocols & Frameworks**: Strong understanding of Model Context Protocols (MCP), A2A protocols, and Agent Developer Kits.
* **LLM Engineering**: Practical proficiency in prompting techniques, fine-tuning workflows, and evaluating LLM outputs.
* **Data Science Stack**: Strong hands-on experience leveraging Python, pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch.
* **Cloud & MLOps**: Experience deploying and scaling machine learning solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* **DevOps & Containers**: Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and GitHub Actions.
* **Backend Stack**: Production-grade backend coding skills in Python, with basic familiarity in JavaScript/TypeScript for API integrations.

Mandatory Skills: GenAI Consulting for Apps & Infra

## Job Description

Job Description – Full Stack Developer (Java, Spring Framework & React)  
Position Overview  
We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in Java 8/11/17+, Spring Framework ecosystem, React, and Microsoft SQL Server to design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience across the full software development lifecycle, including requirement analysis, architecture design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. This role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, architects, QA teams, and DevOps engineers to deliver high-quality solutions.  
Application Development  
Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end web applications and enterprise software solutions.  
Build scalable, secure, and high-performance backend services using Java 8/11/17+ and Spring Framework 3.x / Spring Boot 3.x technologies.  
Develop responsive and intuitive user interfaces using React, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and jQuery.  
Participate in system design discussions, architecture reviews, and technical solutioning.  
Experience & Qualifications  
Relevant Experience: Minimum 5+ years in Java Full Stack Development  
Domain Experience (Preferred): Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, or Enterprise Application Development  
Key Responsibilities  
Backend Development  
Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and high-performance backend applications using Java technologies.  
Build microservices and RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and MyBatis.  
Implement business logic, security controls, validation mechanisms, and integration services.  
Develop reusable components and frameworks to improve development efficiency.

## Long Description

Optimize application performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.  
Implement authentication and authorization using Spring Security, OAuth2, JWT, and SSO integrations.  
Develop cloud-native and microservices-based applications leveraging Spring Cloud components.
